newsitem.title: JAPAN: JVC to launch DVD player next spring.
newsitem.headline: JVC to launch DVD player next spring.

text.p: Victor Co of Japan Ltd (JVC) said on Tuesday that it would launch digital video disc (DVD) players in Japan and the United States in March or April next year.
A JVC spokesman did not elaborate further on the planned launch.
DVD is a new recording system which has large storage capacity and is expected to eventually make videocassette recorders, compact disc (CD) players and CD-ROMs obsolete.
Earlier on Tuesday, JVC said it would start production of DVD discs at JVC Disc America Co, its subsidiary in the United States, in April 1997. The company plans monthly output of 600,000 discs.
This would be JVC's first DVD disc production, the spokesman said.
